results.notes: Question page: no. Items from mustShow: Pip, Sam, May, Ben, Mia, Pat, Lily, Nan, Teacher Kim (9 figures). Page text: a call to Pip to put on a hat; action is a note only. Children counted one by one, left to right: 1 boy in a striped shirt and shorts, short side fringe = Sam; 2 girl in a pleated skirt with a fringe and a tied tuft or clip at the top left of her head = May (small mark: the ponytail is hard to read); 3 boy with messy spiky hair, T-shirt, shorts = Ben; 4 child with a smooth cap of hair, a small bow at the right side, body half hidden by the hat of Pip = Mia (small mark: hair short for shoulder-length); 5 boy with tufts on top, T-shirt, cargo shorts = Pat; 6 girl with a bob, straight fringe, a bow at the side, a collared dress = Lily; 7 girl with two round buns and a band, star on the T-shirt = Nan. That is 7 children, all drawn and clear. Pip: a puppy with floppy ears, a nose, sitting in a box and wearing a hat; reads as Pip (small mark: the collar is hard to see). Teacher Kim: a woman standing behind the children in an open cardigan over a blouse and trousers, but her hair is a big, voluminous curly shape around the face. The cast note gives medium-length hair in a low ponytail, smooth and tied back. The curly hair reads as a different woman (like Grandma), so this is a changed character. Line art: black lines on white, no gray, no gaps that make coloring hard, no text.
